claims.claim: ploader reads plugins from local /data/plugins/ploader.ini; ini path constant
ploader has NO network code in the injection path (includes are kernel/ptrace/stdio only; no sys/socket, no http)
run_plugins outer loop: while(!all_injected) with global 120 s cap (INJECTOR_TIMEOUT_S)
each pid is processed EXACTLY ONCE per ploader invocation: new pids are appended to `known` and skipped on all later passes (no in-invocation retry of a failed title)
plugins of a title run strictly serially in ini order inside one for-loop; per-plugin: readiness wait -> ptrace attach -> creds -> inject -> notify -> restore -> detach, then next plugin
per-plugin readiness wait wait_for_needs runs BEFORE every plugin (per-plugin, not per-title); mode 2 params stable_ms=1000, min_mod=16, settle_ms=600; max wait 25000 ms for mode 2 / 18000 for mode 1
wait_stable polls at 50 ms ticks; needs stable_req=max(2,stable_ms/50)=20 consecutive stable ticks for mode 2, then settle usleep(600 ms), then re-verify; falls through to 'try anyway' after max_ms
MINIMUM per-plugin readiness cost when game already ready: 20 ticks x 50 ms + 600 ms settle = ~1.6 s, charged once per plugin per invocation
MISSING FILE fails INSTANTLY: inject_prx first does access(path,R_OK) and returns -1 with no retry, no sleep, no timeout; there is no per-file wait in ploader
pt_attach: up to 3 retries with 300 ms delay; each attempt allows 2000 ms waitpid; worst ~7 s
inject_prx copies path+shellcode into the tracee and calls pt_call on the shellcode; module load runs as sceKernelLoadStartModule(path,0,0,0,0,0) inside the game process

pt_call = PT_CONTINUE then waitpid_timeout(...,30000 ms): ploader WAITS FOR module_start's RETURN (shellcode INT3 fires only after `call r15` returns) with a 30 s CAP; on timeout it restores regs (attempt ignored), FAILs the plugin, and moves on WITHOUT waiting for the still-running module_start (no join)
OK/FAIL toast dt measures inject_prx wall time ~= module_start duration when under the 30 s cap; emission points are the notify calls after rc>0 check
after injection there is NO runtime-initialization wait: loop proceeds to next plugin or exits; 'Finished' notify at end of main
notify() only sends sceKernelSendNotificationRequest toasts; nothing is written to any log file (no persistent ploader step log)
transfer protocol: PRXs are read from local /data at injection; HTTP 8084 (pldmgr) and FTP 2121 are staging-time channels only, not part of boot injection (no fetch/cache logic exists in ploader)
config parse: mode value 0 disables, 1 early, 2 late; entries registered in file order (ini order = execution order per title)
